Technician.title: Technician
Technician.description: Represents a nail technician registered on the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Technician entity.

serviceRadius.description: Service radius in miles from the technician's home base.

applicationStatus.description: Status of the technician's application (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

bio.description: A short biography of the technician.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the technician's profile image.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Represents a customer using the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Customer entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the customer's profile image.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a service offered by the technicians.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Service entity.

name.description: Name of the service (e.g., Manicure, Pedicure).

duration.description: Duration of the service in minutes.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a booking made by a customer for a technician's service.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Booking entity.

status.description: Status of the booking (e.g., booked, confirmed, completed, cancelled).

totalAmount.description: Total amount for the booking (including service price, add-ons, and tips).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used (e.g., credit card, Stripe).

transactionId.description: Transaction ID from the payment gateway (e.g., Stripe).

status.description: Status of the payment (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

AddOn.title: AddOn
AddOn.description: Represents an add-on service that can be requested during a booking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AddOn entity.

name.description: Name of the add-on service (e.g., Gel Polish).

status.description: Status of the add-on request (e.g., requested, approved, rejected).

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Represents a review of a technician by a customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Review entity.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the Nails On the Go application, focusing on technician onboarding, mobile booking, in-app payments, and job management. It prioritizes authorization independence and secure list operations. User data (Technicians and Customers) is stored in path-based collections for simple ownership checks. Booking, Payment, AddOn, and Review entities are modeled to maintain clear relationships and support denormalization for authorization.

Authorization Independence is achieved by denormalizing authorization-relevant data. For instance, the `Bookings` collection includes the `customerId` and `technicianId`, allowing security rules to validate access without needing to perform additional `get()` calls. The `Technicians` collection is segregated from customer data to ensure technicians' sensitive information remains secure. The use of path-based ownership (`/users/{userId}/...`) and denormalized IDs within documents helps avoid complex hierarchical dependencies and maintains atomic operations.

QAPs are supported by segregating data with different access requirements into distinct collections. Technician applications, for example, are managed separately from approved technician profiles. The structure uses path-based ownership for user-specific data, which supports secure `list` operations. For collaborative data, the membership map approach (though not directly implemented here due to the nature of the entities) could be applied in future collaborative features to ensure only authorized users can access specific resources.
